description: Land Acquisition - Rambukpotha, Medadumbara D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It details the specific land parcels being acquired (Dothulukanda, lots 02 and 03), their extent, location, and the purpose (Knuckles Range Reservation). It contains no government personnel changes, structural changes, or elements that would fit Types 1-3. The content is purely land/property-related, making it a clear Type 4 (Land Gazette).
